coverage_boundary: Compiled from the current conversation, available prior-conversation summaries, selected private Plugin Creator read-backs and GitHub repository/PR read-backs on 12 November 2026. records.scope: Creative direction per brief; no deceptive clickbait, fear manipulation or unsupported health claims.

records.scope: Tie CTA to defined audience and behavior objective; do not globalize campaign-specific CTA.

records.scope: Optional brand profile element; confirm current brand fit, spelling and authority before reuse.

open_decisions: Raw full history and all prior project artifacts were not available; this register remains summary-bounded.
Owner confirmation is needed for the proposed relationship between GitHub S10 editing-postproduction and private S10 renderer-code-engineering.
Private legacy CTRL engine and GitHub V4-CTL candidate stay separate until independent review, authorized merge, main CI and controlled synchronization.
Private-only executable-gate helper and Remotion adapter/assets remain outside verified GitHub source parity.
Canonical private plugin name, GitHub root manifest name and repository identity require explicit owner confirmation before rename.
Brand approval is not recorded for reusing Halo Sola Seha’ or Polewali Mandar dialect in every campaign.
Video aspect ratio, resolution, platform, duration, audio policy, renderer and AI model remain project-specific until selected.
Social reach, FYP, trending and engagement outcomes cannot be promised; project analytics and platform context are needed for measurement.
Live ChatGPT invocation, real ASR/diarization, Remotion runtime/render, MP4 QA and human clinical/legal/rights/privacy/brand/accessibility approvals remain NOT_RUN or NOT_VERIFIED.
Open-source license and third-party redistribution rights are unknown; public repository visibility is not a license.
